episodes.title: The Power of Grayskull
episodes.summary: Eternia celebrates Teela as its new Man-At-Arms, but the knighting ceremony is cut short when Skeletor leads a full-scale attack on Grayskull.

episodes.title: Poisoned Chalice
episodes.summary: Now mercenaries, Teela and her partner accept a job from a mysterious woman: to retrieve an old goblet from deep within Snake Mountain.

episodes.title: The Most Dangerous Man in Eternia
episodes.summary: While defending a village from Tri-Klops's cult, Teela's group meets Man-At-Arms, who is struggling to keep Orko alive using the town's magic water.

episodes.title: Land of the Dead
episodes.summary: Separated from her companions in Subternia, Teela faces a sinister entity who offers her half of the Sword of Power in exchange for her fears.

episodes.title: The Forge at the Forest of Forever
episodes.summary: A familiar figure warns Teela and the others that there may be no escape from Preternia. Roboto risks his mechanical body to reforge the Sword of Power.

episodes.title: Cleaved in Twain
episodes.summary: While the Sorceress, Adam and the others look on helplessly, Skeletor exploits his newfound power to evil lengths, plunging Eternia into chaos.

episodes.title: Reason and Blood
episodes.summary: Adam calls down the power of Grayskull without wielding the sword and clashes with Skeletor, then sets his sights on an improbable target.

episodes.title: The Gutter Rat
episodes.summary: As Evil-Lyn begins to doubt Skeletor's motives, she recalls how she first met the power-mad tyrant and ultimately decides to make an unexpected move.

episodes.title: Hope, For a Destination
episodes.summary: Aware of her legacy, Teela tries to manifest her powers to call for aid in their struggle against Evil-Lyn, while Adam partners with an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Comes with Everything You See Here
episodes.summary: Teela assumes her new role and Adam reclaims the Sword of Power as the final confrontation for the fate of Eternia — and the entire universe — begins.
